2226-4518-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4518-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

955-1456-5078-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

141-4454-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4454-6797.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1477-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1477-5777-7810.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Extruder ability
Repeat.

2021-2060-3129-3921.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

372-4783-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and making it an artifact creature until end of turn.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Repeat.

1322-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1322-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1987-4276-4863-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-4863-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Revolutionist and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4863-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable, reduced by Semblance Anvil.

443-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-5231-7084.description:

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.

Repeat.

Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Hardened Scales.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
2265-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

193-2369-3604.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.

Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-2369-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.
